wrote /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/obj/drop_new_line.py: """`SplFileObject::DROP_NEW_LINE` kept the newline on every plain-line read.

The flag was honoured only on the READ_CSV path. MEASURED on `php -n` 8.5.6 over
`"a\\rb\\nc\\r\\n\\nd"` with the flag set, one hex line per record:

    610d62 | 63 | (empty) | 64

so the trailing terminator goes and an INTERIOR carriage return stays — `"a\\rb\\n"` becomes
`"a\\rb"`, not `"a"`. That rules out truncating at the first `\\r` or `\\n`; it is a trailing trim of
`"\\r\\n"`, which `rtrim($line, "\\r\\n")` performs exactly, a line never holding an interior `\\n`.
